QuestInfo.name: [Esfera] Collecting Erda
QuestInfo.0: How do you watch the distorted Erda? It seems Melange wrote a hint on the note.
QuestInfo.1: You need to inject stabilized Erda to watch the distorted Erda. Collect around 10 #bErda Energies#k from the nearby enemies.
QuestInfo.2: You stabilized the distorted Erda and watched the power in the Erda. Inside was someone's memory... none other than #bTana's#k. What appeared in her memory was... #rCommander Will#k?!

item.0: You don't have enough Erda Energy.
